fix: In the breaker population pass: for digests not matching any exact-fingerprint group, compute normalized-token LCS ratio pairwise within the batch window (N is small, <=20 digests; O(N^2 * L^2) is trivial); band >=0.9 joins the group. Pin with the historical pairs that SHOULD have banded (1146/1148 duration variants pre-#370) and pairs that must NOT (1137/1139/1143 distinct defects).
notes: From the 2026-07-30 literature review; deterministic, Go-native, no embeddings.
summary: Crash-dedup research (Igor CCS'21, ECHO 2025) shows exact hashing both over-splits (noise tokens) and over-merges (generic frames) — the exact arc of our fingerprint fixes (#368 content-free templates, #370 duration tokens, #376 constant epilogue reasons; each fixed one over-split/over-merge by hand). The structural next step: a similarity band — two normalized reason strings with >=0.9 token-LCS ratio count as the SAME recurrence even when their hashes differ (one path segment, one attempt number the normalizers do not yet fold). Keeps the exact-hash rule as tier 1; the LCS band is tier 2 with its own ceiling and a distinct halt message naming both members.
title: Blocker breaker: LCS near-identical band beside the exact-hash rule (Igor/ECHO crash-dedup shape)
